parameters.name: ChannelId
parameters.description: The ID of the driver channel. Call the [QueryEdgeInstanceChannel](~~162253~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: DriverId
parameters.description:
The ID of the driver. On the **Driver Management** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target driver name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the target edge instance name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: IotIds
parameters.description:
The list of sub-device IDs. Call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) operation to query sub-device IDs.

> You can specify up to 20 sub-device IDs in a single call.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.
